cues.text: Rows of silhouetted soldiers face an Earth-like planet.
Two sleek ships fly toward the Earth-like world. It rushes closer, expanding until it swallows everything in white.
An explorer touches a tiny sprout in the snow.
A reptilian alien kneels, offering fruit.
An officer plants a red flag.
An armored soldier, a mechanic, and a scientist.
The trio are painted on a glowing billboard.
It overlooks a vast, dark, industrialized metropolis.
Thick yellow smog chokes the air between jagged skyscrapers.

beats.note: The stern, white-bearded Emperor Zelevas wears a black coat with a high collar against a red background.
He stands before a silhouetted cheering crowd.
A female pilot in a red flight suit salutes.
A small white ship flies past.
An Earth-like planet appears.
Rows of silhouetted soldiers face the planet.
A smiling woman operates a large mechanical loader.
The loader lifts massive metal beams.
Silhouettes of futuristic city buildings rise.
A massive blocky warship bursts through the screen.
A man in a trench coat gazes at a distant white planet.
Two sleek ships fly toward the planet.
The ships approach the planet, which rushes closer and fills the screen with white.
A woman in a white space suit floats playfully.
A figure in heavy red winter gear kneels on a snowy surface to touch a tiny green sprout.
Silhouettes of colonists disembark a ship.
A smiling officer accepts a bowl of green fruit from a kneeling reptilian alien.
The officer stands proudly with a red flag.
He plants the flag atop a rocky peak.
An armored soldier stands between a mechanic and a scientist.
Text reads, A BRIGHTER FUTURE TOGETHER.
The trio are revealed to be painted on a glowing billboard.
The billboard overlooks a dark, industrialized metropolis.
Thick smog chokes the air between jagged skyscrapers.
The city fades to black.
